title: Multi-column selections in `st.dataframe` should be additive
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

When activating multi-column selections in `st.dataframe`, clicking on a new column changes the selection to that column. You need to shift-click to add the column to the selection. Instead, we should add the clicked column to the selection upon a normal click. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/447b75fa-4c54-43e4-8b65-dfa5abaa1488

 

### Why?

- More in line with how multi-row selections work. 
- Easier to use on mobile. Today, you effectively can't do multi-column selections on mobile since you can't shift-click. 

### How?

_No response_
